cr_title: Soil extracellular DNA fragments show variable degradation rates among sequences and environmental conditions
relevance: Demonstrates that extracellular DNA exhibits sequence-specific persistence spanning weeks to years under dry conditions, potentially skewing metagenomic gene copy quantification.
title: Soil extracellular DNA fragments show variable degradation rates among sequences and environmental conditions

cr_title: Average genome size estimation improves comparative metagenomics and sheds light on the functional ecology of the human microbiome
relevance: Establishes estimation of average genome size and genome equivalents from universal single-copy genes to normalize functional marker counts against sequencing depth and genome size variations.
title: Average genome size estimation improves comparative metagenomics and sheds light on the functional ecology of the human microbiome

cr_title: ROCker: accurate detection and quantification of target genes in short-read metagenomic data sets by modeling sliding-window bitscores
relevance: Demonstrates that fixed-threshold BLAST searches yield severe false positives from shared homologous domains, validating the necessity of competitive matching to quantify functional markers accurately.
title: ROCker: accurate detection and quantification of target genes in short-read metagenomic data sets by modeling sliding-window bitscores

cr_title: Thousands of microbial genomes shed light on interconnected biogeochemical processes in an aquifer system
relevance: Established the 16 curated HMM profiles that define subgroups of [NiFe] and [FeFe] hydrogenases across uncultivated environmental lineages.
title: Thousands of microbial genomes shed light on interconnected biogeochemical processes in an aquifer system

cr_title: Evaluating rRNA as an indicator of microbial activity in environmental communities: limitations and uses
relevance: Highlights that DNA-based metagenomic gene counts capture dormant and relic cells in arid soils, cautioning that genomic capacity significantly overestimates active atmospheric gas uptake.
title: Evaluating rRNA as an indicator of microbial activity in environmental communities: limitations and uses

cr_title: Historical climate controls soil respiration responses to current soil moisture
cr_journal: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences
relevance: Demonstrates that historical precipitation regimes create persistent legacy effects that constrain contemporary microbial functional responses, supporting why antecedent precipitation history does not shift genomic capacity.
title: Historical climate controls soil respiration responses to current soil moisture
